title: lut ta hai ahmad ka chaman haaye haaye
body:
lut ta hai ahmad ka chaman haaye haaye
qalq se jaate hai hassan haaye haaye
aabe sam aalood ke peene se aah
hogaya neela wo badan haaye haaye
<<DIVIDER>>
tukde kaleja jo hua qoon se
hogaya labrez lagan haaye haaye
sarfe buka saara madina hai aaj
peet'ti hai sheh ki behen haaye haaye
<<DIVIDER>>
teer sitamgaaro ne taboot par
maare hai ya shaahe zaman haaye haaye
